checks.message: The complete package passes deterministic schema, manifest, scope, size, bilingual and integrity validation.
Projected-area, topology and metric recalculation checks pass; provisional-boundary notices remain non-blocking and explicit.
Offline visual packaging, local assets and displayed structured metrics pass the visual review.
Provisional overall boundary is present and explicitly not claimed as official.
Three required key areas are present and explicitly labelled provisional; the Dazhongsi placeholder was map-cross-checked and relocated without claiming official precision.
The offline OSM context preserves query, bbox, retrieval date, raw hash, ODbL attribution and a prohibition on official-boundary or planning-control use.
Land-use polygons are a shared-edge projected partition of the submitted site geometry.
Static offline HTML uses local assets and exact structured metric values.
All required chapters contain claim-adjacent evidence anchors and depth references.
Chinese and English narrative, report, visual, figures and PDF deliverables are paired.
All public AI scenarios are governed by an eight-field passport, human fallback, maintenance and retirement gates.
